_doc: An extra registry (pass --registry tools/review/pool/measures_heatflow.json): the `hfcells` measure, the continental heat flow of the final frame (PLT-469's lane), and the heat-flow fields in every run's dump. Runs made without it have no heat flow in their dump, so a comparison against a run made without it needs an arm of the same key with the switch off.

hfcells.doc: Continental L1 cells under 54.9 mW/m2 and the continental heat flow's minimum, percentile, median, mean and maximum and its shares over 150 and 200 mW/m2 on the final frame; definitions in measure_hfcells.py

columns.label: continental heat flow, minimum, mW/m2 (the thermal state's craton floor 41 since 2026-10-23)
share of continental cells over 150 mW/m2 (Earth's regional maxima 100 to 150, PLT-823)
share of continental cells over 200 mW/m2 (above it only geothermal fields, PLT-823)
